body: This appears to be nearly the same as #91374 . I'll take a closer look later and test if your PR also fixes #91336 since I was pursuing a different goal.

Sorry, I didn't see your PR, since you did mention it was for a different goal. It looks like we did mainly the same things in our PRs, though, so the fixes should be identical for both issues.

I could try testing your PR to see if it works, though the merge conflicts would probably have to be resolved first (not sure what the conflicts are, though).

Took a closer look at your changes, and rebased my PR. The only differences between our solutions:

- The `Translations and Remaps` block is in a slightly different place. Likely won't make a difference in practice.
- You've changed the timing of `memdelete`, which I didn't. I always assumed it should be kept, since we also didn't move the `memnew` call. Unless there is another reason for moving it?
- I ensured that none of the engine initialization code uses translations too early, which you didn't seem to. Note the changes of `RTR` to `TTRC` in my PR.

I've also tested #101073 with my PR and it is fixed.

So in conclusion your PR can probably be closed as it is basically a duplicate? But I would appreciate a review if you have any feedback for me :)

> * The `Translations and Remaps` block is in a slightly different place. Likely won't make a difference in practice.

I assumed the `cmdline_args` might be important since it was in the `MODULE_MONO_ENABLED` block, so I moved the `Translations and Remaps` block after it just in case. But like you said, it may not have made any difference.
> * You've changed the timing of `memdelete`, which I didn't. I always assumed it should be kept, since we also didn't move the `memnew` call. Unless there is another reason for moving it?
